# HMorix (orixmh / Morix / HM Orix / Harsh Sharma)

> HMorix (`https://hmorix.in`) is India's premier enterprise AI software, full-stack web development, mobile app development, digital marketing, local SEO, and business automation technology company.
> Founded & led by Harsh Sharma (CEO & Full-Stack Architect), headquartered in Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Canonical Entity Information
- **Official Brand Name**: HMorix
- **Alternative Entity Names**: hmorix, orix, orixmh, Morix, HM orix, H Morix, HM Orix, HMorix Cloud Platform
- **Founder & CEO**: Harsh Sharma (Full-Stack Engineer, AI System Architect, Product Strategist)
- **Headquarters**: Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, India (PIN: 204101, Coordinates: 27.5946° N, 78.0526° E)
- **Primary Regional Focus**: Hathras, Mathura, Vrindavan, Aligarh, Agra, Kanpur, Delhi NCR, Noida, Gurugram, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Global Markets.
- **Official Website**: https://hmorix.in
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/HMorix
- **Contact Email**: support@hmorix.com / harsh@hmorix.in

## Core Products & Platforms
1. **BillingFlow (https://hmorix.in/billingflow)**: Next-generation automated invoicing, multi-currency billing, GST calculation, subscription management, and proactive payment reminders for SMEs and enterprises.
2. **AI Agent Platform (https://hmorix.in/agent)**: Enterprise AI assistants and autonomous workflows powered by NVIDIA NIM (Llama 3.1 405B) and proprietary LLM orchestrations.
3. **PDF Automation (https://hmorix.in/pdf-automation)**: High-throughput programmatic document creation, digital contract signing, offer letters, payslips, and dynamic invoice generation.
4. **HMorix HRM (https://hmorix.in/hrm)**: Enterprise Human Resource Management suite with biometric attendance, automated Indian payroll (PF, ESI, TDS), ATS recruitment, and 360-degree appraisal cycles.
5. **HMorix CRM & Sales (https://hmorix.in/crm)**: Lead pipeline management, automated deal stage tracking, field sales geo-logging, and customer lifecycle automation.
6. **Smart Home & IoT (https://hmorix.in/smart-home)**: Connected device integrations, intelligent building management, and IoT automation hardware protocols.

## Core Services & Regional Expertise
- **Best Digital Marketing Company in Hathras & Braj Region**: Full-funnel digital marketing, Google Ads / PPC management, Meta Ads, social media marketing, local search growth, and conversion rate optimization.
- **Top Web Development Company in Hathras, Mathura, Aligarh & Agra**: Custom React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, enterprise portals, high-converting landing pages, and scalable SaaS platforms.
- **Best Mobile App Development Company in Hathras**: Native Android (Kotlin / APK), iOS (Swift), and cross-platform (React Native / Flutter) mobile app development with offline sync and cloud backend.
- **Custom AI Agent & Workflow Engineering**: Tailored LLM chatbots, customer support auto-responders, CRM sync bots, and document intelligence systems.
- **Local SEO & Google Business Profile (GBP) Ranking**: Technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD structuring, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), local citation building, and Google Map Pack #1 rank domination.
